I’ve never had trouble getting an appointment and find the receptionists extremely helpful regarding my needs. All the GP’s are excellent and mine has been an integral part of helping me get the right care for my health needs. The office staff have always been excellent when dealing with referrals and if I could give a higher rating for this surgery then I would.
I agree it can be frustrating if you are in the phone queue in the morning but the surgery cannot predict how many people are ill on one particular day and the pressure they are under to answer your call as quickly as possible and find you an appointment can be extremely stressful for them especially if people are then rude to them. has been frustrating trying to access the necessary medical care. When calling in the morning, calls seem to be deleted, causing my place in the queue to drop from 9th to over 30th, often resulting in no available appointments.

The reception staff have been unhelpful; they are unable to book a follow-up appointment requested by the doctor and instead direct me to an online system where booking isn’t possible. Additionally, they refused to take two minutes to record my blood pressure results over four days, which means I now have to visit the surgery—a difficult task due to my disability and caring responsibilities for my ill son.

My son has had flu symptoms for two months, with frequent fevers over 40°C, yet last Friday, the doctor dismissed it, insisting he was fine. As a result, he is still unwell.

On top of this, I submitted university paperwork to be completed, but the staff misplaced it for two weeks.

The overall experience has been incredibly challenging due to disorganized and unhelpful
